files.system/contracts/task-scope.yaml:
# The task-scope contract: what binds a task, stated instead of judged.
#
# The normative corpus answers what binds. This file answers what binds
# *this* task: the entry read that starts it, the executable procedure that
# carries it, and the current binding documents that scope it.
#
# system/OPERATOR.md renders its "Start here" table from this file, so the
# operator contract and the machine surface cannot disagree. A scope entry
# is a whole document or one of its level-2 sections (`path#anchor`), and
# `capabilities TASK --json` inlines every procedure and scoped section,
# bounded. Every scoped document must be a current binding document in
# system/contracts/normative-corpus.yaml; every procedure must name a
# runnable system/procedures/*.md transcript and a heading that exists in
# it; every command in an entry read must be a real CLI verb.
contract: learningos-task-scope
schema_version: 1

tasks:
  - id: discover-capabilities
    task: Discover capabilities
    entry_read: '`capabilities --compact --json`, then `capabilities NAME --json`'
    procedures:
      - label: Discover and expand
        target: system/procedures/start-here.md#discover-the-capability-index
    scope:
      - system/OPERATOR.md

  - id: log-a-line
    task: Log a line (`log:`)
    entry_read: '`capabilities capture.create --json`, or `capabilities stage.note.write --json` for an identified stage'
    procedures:
      - label: Log to the stage
        target: system/procedures/capture-routing.md#a-logged-line-for-an-identified-stage-is-one-stage-note-write
      - label: log to the inbox
        target: system/procedures/capture-routing.md#a-logged-line-with-no-stage-is-one-inbox-capture
    scope:
      - system/OPERATOR.md
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#2-capture-temporary-material
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#25c-build-a-write-envelope-gatewayenvelopev2

  - id: record-stage-progress
    task: Record stage progress or end a session
    entry_read: '`capabilities stage.progress.update --json`'
    procedures:
      - label: Read the stage-progress payload
        target: system/procedures/end-a-session.md#read-the-stage-progress-payload-contract
      - label: review the session
        target: system/procedures/end-a-session.md#step-3-review-the-session
    scope:
      - system/OPERATOR.md
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#22-end-a-session
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#25c-build-a-write-envelope-gatewayenvelopev2

  - id: create-or-revise-a-durable-note
    task: Create or revise a durable note
    entry_read: '`capabilities note.create --json`, or `capabilities note.revise --json` for an existing note'
    procedures:
      - label: Search for an existing note first
        target: system/procedures/create-durable-note.md#search-for-an-existing-note-with-the-same-purpose
      - label: the creation payload
        target: system/procedures/create-durable-note.md#seal-the-creation-with-derived-guards
    scope:
      - system/OPERATOR.md
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#3-create-or-evolve-a-durable-note
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#25c-build-a-write-envelope-gatewayenvelopev2

  - id: save-source-analyses
    task: Save source analyses
    entry_read: '`capabilities note.analysis.save_batch --json`'
    procedures:
      - label: Draft one batch
        target: system/procedures/save-a-batch-of-source-analyses.md#draft-the-first-batch-two-notes-one-drafts-file
      - label: prepare it
        target: system/procedures/save-a-batch-of-source-analyses.md#prepare-the-first-batch
    scope:
      - system/OPERATOR.md
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#25b-save-a-batch-of-source-analyses
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#25c-build-a-write-envelope-gatewayenvelopev2

  - id: edit-a-known-material-route
    task: Edit a known material route
    entry_read: '`plan-edit-context UNIT_ID --route-id ROUTE_ID` or `--route-ids A B`'
    procedures:
      - label: Revise a plan
        target: system/procedures/revise-an-existing-plan.md#start-from-the-named-routes-edit-context
    scope:
      - system/OPERATOR.md
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#25a-revise-an-existing-plan
      - system/ARCHITECTURE.md#14a-module-first-curriculum-model

  - id: edit-a-known-stage
    task: Edit a known stage
    entry_read: '`plan-edit-context UNIT_ID --stage-id STAGE_ID`'
    procedures:
      - label: Enter through the stage
        target: system/procedures/bootstrap-order.md#enter-through-the-named-stage
    scope:
      - system/OPERATOR.md
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#25a-revise-an-existing-plan
      - system/ARCHITECTURE.md#14a-module-first-curriculum-model

  - id: unit-coverage-and-unknown-ids
    task: Unit coverage, source completeness, or unknown IDs
    entry_read: '`plan-edit-context UNIT_ID --brief`'
    procedures:
      - label: Choose the focused context
        target: system/procedures/start-here.md#follow-one-printed-expansion-with-its-snapshot-pin
    scope:
      - system/OPERATOR.md
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#25a-revise-an-existing-plan
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#26-source-routing-and-feedback

  - id: open-work-or-priority-question
    task: Open work or priority question
    entry_read: '`bootstrap --brief`, then `inspect WORKSPACE_ID` and relevant coordination'
    procedures:
      - label: Read operational state
        target: system/procedures/retrieval-behavior.md#orient-operational-questions-from-the-brief
    scope:
      - system/OPERATOR.md
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#25-the-two-layer-operating-model-adr-006
      - system/CLAUDE.md

  - id: known-record-or-stage-note
    task: Known record or stage note
    entry_read: '`inspect ID`, including a batch of known IDs'
    procedures:
      - label: Read one record
        target: system/procedures/start-here.md#read-one-named-record
      - label: read one stage note
        target: system/procedures/start-here.md#read-one-named-stage-with-its-working-note-content
    scope:
      - system/OPERATOR.md
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#25-the-two-layer-operating-model-adr-006

  - id: note-body-or-saved-reasoning
    task: Note body or saved reasoning
    entry_read: '`note-read NOTE_ID`'
    procedures:
      - label: Read saved reasoning
        target: system/procedures/start-here.md#search-beyond-note-summaries-then-read-the-saved-reasoning
    scope:
      - system/OPERATOR.md
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#25-the-two-layer-operating-model-adr-006

  - id: material-or-concept-explanation
    task: Material or concept explanation
    entry_read: '`material-context`, then an exact `material-span` when needed'
    procedures:
      - label: Retrieve explanations
        target: system/procedures/retrieval-behavior.md#read-what-explains-it
    scope:
      - system/OPERATOR.md
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#26-source-routing-and-feedback

  - id: resume-recorded-study
    task: Resume recorded study
    entry_read: '`resume` or `resume --study`'
    procedures:
      - label: Resume without moving state
        target: system/procedures/start-here.md#the-study-suggestion-never-moves-the-resume-pointer
    scope:
      - system/OPERATOR.md
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#25-the-two-layer-operating-model-adr-006
      - system/CLAUDE.md

  - id: changes-awaiting-a-decision
    task: Changes awaiting a decision
    entry_read: '`intelligence-scan --brief --json`'
    procedures:
      - label: Read the decision queue
        target: system/procedures/start-here.md#read-what-wants-a-decision
    scope:
      - system/OPERATOR.md
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#30-review-exact-goal-decisions-together

  - id: ability-evidence
    task: Ability evidence
    entry_read: '`ability-context` horizon, then a known ability'
    procedures:
      - label: Read a bounded ability
        target: system/procedures/start-here.md#read-one-ability-through-the-bounded-horizon
    scope:
      - system/OPERATOR.md
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#8-record-evidence

  - id: governance-question
    task: Governance question
    entry_read: '`semantic --list`, then `semantic PREDICATE --input k=v`'
    procedures:
      - label: Ask the semantic surface
        target: system/procedures/start-here.md#ask-a-governance-question-through-the-semantic-surface
    scope:
      - system/OPERATOR.md
      - system/SEMANTIC-CONTRACT.md

  - id: process-a-lecture
    task: Process a lecture (23)
    entry_read: '`capabilities module.plan.import --json`, then `plan-edit-context UNIT_ID --brief`'
    procedures:
      - label: Process a lecture end to end
        target: system/procedures/process-a-lecture.md#materials-in-the-deck-lands-in-the-materials-tree
      - label: Package, preflight and apply the lecture unit
        target: system/procedures/process-a-lecture.md#package-and-preflight-the-lecture-unit
    scope:
      - system/OPERATOR.md
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#23-process-a-lecture
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#6-add-or-evaluate-a-source

  - id: untranscribable-workflows
    task: Turn the semester (24), promote a Master's module (27)
    entry_read: none — stop and ask
    procedures: []
    procedure_text: >-
      none: these two have no executable transcript, and the scope authority
      they need does not exist in a checkout (boundary 18)
    scope:
      - system/OPERATOR.md
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#24-turn-the-semester
      - system/WORKFLOWS.md#27-promote-a-future-masters-module
